text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I lost to Taiki, but I showed my 
potential! That's a pass on the test! Next 
year, I'm taking on the world!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, what!? Taiki is going abroad too!? 
She wants to race against me on the world 
stage!?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Guh, a total bolt from the blue! Next up 
is the Takamatsunomiya Kinen! I'll build 
momentum at my best distance and show the 
world what I'm made of!
